concept: Mill-floor foreman gone bad: huge barrel-chested man in his fifties, grey walrus moustache, yellow hard hat, red boiler suit with the sleeves torn off, hi-vis vest, big leather work gloves, steel-toe boots, a heavy spanner hanging from his belt. Slow, super-armoured, charges across the screen like a bull; overhead double-fist slam.

generator.mode: PixelLab v3, 96px canvas, side view, facing right, native size (set target_height to the base's real height, scale 1.0). Generate the base in the fighting stance and use it as the start frame for every animation.
generator.prompt: huge barrel-chested mill foreman in his fifties, grey walrus moustache, yellow hard hat, red boiler suit with torn-off sleeves, orange hi-vis vest, big leather work gloves, steel-toe boots, heavy spanner on his belt, standing in a wide fighting stance with fists up, full body, detailed 32-bit pixel art, clean dark outline

animation_notes.slam: overhead double-fist slam down in front of him, forward
animation_notes.charge: head-down bull charge, leaning far forward, running forward
animation_notes.charge_windup: scrapes his boot and lowers his head before charging

idle.note: raw/pixellab/idle frames 0-4-1 ping-pong (second take; later frames turn toward the camera, as all of the first take did)

walk.note: raw/pixellab/walk frames 1-8 (0 is the stance start frame)

slam.note: raw/pixellab/slam frames 0-7, then 4 as the recovery (second take; the first punched forward). The overhead raise (1-4) becomes the windup

hurt.note: raw/pixellab/knockdown frames 1-2-3-2-1: the backward stagger before the fall (v3 hurt turned to camera; the taking-punch template came out smaller on a 96px canvas)

getup.note: raw/pixellab/getup frames 1-10; generated from knockdown frame 10 to the stance, 140x132 cropped (6,2) back to the shared 128x128 canvas

charge_windup.note: raw/pixellab/charge_windup frames 1-6: lowers his head and leans in

charge.note: raw/pixellab/charge frames 1-8; the game plays it at double speed
